headword: {競合他社|きょうごうたしゃ}

definitions.explanation: Another company that competes in the same market or industry.

examples.japanese: {競合他社|きょうごうたしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注視|ちゅうし}→注視：16389_chuushi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To watch the movements of competing companies closely.

examples.japanese: {競合他社|きょうごうたしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差別化|さべつか}→差別化：18681_sabetsuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧だ。
examples.english: Differentiating ourselves from competitors is a challenge.

examples.japanese: {競合他社|きょうごうたしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新製品|しんせいひん}→新製品：18629_shinseihin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧ことで、{我|わ}が{社|しゃ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{戦略|せんりゃく}→戦略：04869_senryaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見直|みなお}し→見直し：09340_minaoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迫|せま}られている→迫る：03928_semaru⟧。
examples.english: With a competitor announcing a new product, our company is being forced to reconsider its strategy.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{競合|きょうごう}→競合：05082_kyougou⟧ (competition, rivalry) and ⟦{他社|たしゃ}→他社：17803_tasha⟧ (other company). This is standard business vocabulary used in meetings, reports, market analysis, and corporate strategy discussions.

Often shortened to ⟦{競合|きょうごう}→競合：05082_kyougou⟧ alone in business conversation when the context makes it clear that companies are being discussed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {競合他社|きょうごうたしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧: competitor analysis
- {競合他社|きょうごうたしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧: comparison with competitors
- {競合他社|きょうごうたしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負|ま}けない→負ける：01134_makeru⟧: to not lose to competitors
- {競合他社|きょうごうたしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: competitor's products

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ライバル→ライバル：11197_raibaru⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧: rival company — uses the loanword ⟦ライバル→ライバル：11197_raibaru⟧; slightly more casual
- {同業他社|どうぎょうたしゃ}: company in the same industry — emphasizes being in the same business rather than direct competition
- {競争相手|きょうそうあいて}: competitor — more general, can apply to individuals as well
